content:
@everyone
各位翻译志愿者：

感谢大家一直以来为《忘却前夜》翻译工作付出的时间与心血。为了表达谢意，我们准备了一份纪念头像框「巴别塔之章」×1 作为特别奖励，赠送给所有为翻译工作做出过贡献的志愿者。

申请条件:
只要您曾经有过翻译贡献都可以申请，并不要求目前仍在参与志愿者活动，我们会根据实际情况核查并发放。
过往已经领取过该奖励的志愿者，不会重复发放，敬请理解。

请于 <t:1787551200:D> 前填写随本公告一同发布的申请表单，提交后我们将会进行人工核查和奖励发放工作，请耐心等待，有任何问题可以向 @offical staff 寻求帮助。
以下为表单：https://wj.qookkagames.com/p/fSQgZCQm4

再次感谢大家对《忘却前夜》本地化工作的支持与对游戏的热爱！

B.I.A.V. Studio

Dear Translation Volunteers,

Thank you for all the time and effort you've devoted to translating Morimens. As a token of our gratitude, we've prepared a commemorative avatar frame, "Chapter of Babel" ×1, as a special reward for everyone who has contributed to our localization work.

Eligibility: Anyone who has contributed to our translations is welcome to apply — you don't need to be an active volunteer right now. We will review each application and distribute rewards accordingly. If you have already received this reward before, it will not be issued again. Thank you for your understanding.

Please fill in the application form below before  <t:1787551200:D>. After submission, we will manually review all entries and distribute the rewards — thank you for your patience. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to <@&1402550470198825001> for help.

Form: https://wj.qookkagames.com/p/fSQgZCQm4

Thank you again for your support of Morimens' localization, and for your love of the game!

B.I.A.V. Studio
